AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Fruits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. A — 100 °C

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

8. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

9. D — Glucose and oxygen

10. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
